annotations.target_phrase: You were braindead again, five seconds.
annotations.annotation_text: Case's recurrent electroencephalographic 'flatlines' while jacking into the Tessier-Ashpool ICE: crossing the physiological threshold of brain death, guided back only by the Dixie Flatline's construct.
